name: swipe-action-cell
title: Swipe Action Cell
description: A mobile-style list row that reveals quick delete and pin action drawers when swiped horizontally with rubberband drag bounds.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Lateral Horizontal Swipe: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
